organisations: Active ingredient and raw material suppliers
report_definition: The MENA Magnesium Glycinate Market covers magnesium glycinate supplements and finished formulations containing magnesium glycinate as an active nutritional ingredient. This assessment compares leading brands and marketers that supply finished dietary supplements across the Middle East and North Africa region.
player_type_reason: Brand and marketer companies supply finished, retail-ready magnesium glycinate supplements directly to commercial distribution channels. This assessment focuses strictly on these consumer-facing brands, excluding raw material ingredient extractors, bulk chemical brokers, and third-party contract manufacturers that do not market their own proprietary product lines.
